And behold, the matter of <term>Keter</term> <gloss>Crown</gloss> and the emanation of Adam <note>The Primordial Man, Adam Kadmon</note> is explained as <term>Keter</term>, for its foundations are composed.
And now we shall explain the soul of man from <term>Keter</term> to everything beneath it.
Regarding the matters of the words for the existence of its Creator, the end and the end of all from the cycles of knowledge.
The ice for their beauty, and also the mystery of the generation of the four classes at the end of the soul, for everything.
The interruption of all the heavens and all for man whose face is turned, for the surplus and the foundation.
Every order of the suckling line for the day that every action was founded, for within it is a crown like many times.
And they are included in the four elements <note>fire, air, water, and earth</note>, for every master of his action, the surplus and the other straightness within it is its Creator.
The soul of creation <note>the world of Beriah</note> is within it, for the elements are included in the four foundations where it is composed.
From surplus and fear, and both of these are called the intellect of the woman <note>possibly referring to the feminine aspect of the divine, the Shekhinah</note>, blessed be He, and afterwards it suckles.
To the four elements until they are called so to God, blessed be He.
And it has already been explained that the general explanation is for the length of the face <note>term: Arich Anpin, the "Long Face" or "Patient One"</note> and the fear, and they are as in the fourth.
For the length of the face, the soul of this man is judged in his measure upon their thighs, the soul of their movement.
Man is as in everything, for in every human aspect of the world, and they are as the four.
Foundations that include the world. Also know that the general five include the foundations of the essences.
And they are full of the inclusiveness of the world, which are light and fear in relation to the world.

<column-break/>

Below him in every fold, for Lin is called according to a complete suckling. For theקד <note>likely an abbreviation for "Kadosh," Holy</note>.
Every world is nothing, and these are the waters of the spirit's breath with the secret of the Creator of nothingness, which are the four elements.
The world of the heavens is called from the earth of the heavens. And after the light of the soul's world, they were included within it.
Ten types were included, and they are for man, and they correspond to the four elements in the way of the light.
Then he prepared from the heavens that which is nothing, but nothing of the five foundations of his essence.
There are four types of inclusions for man within him, and they are second.
Types of offerings, and they are from him for the whole, for these are within the nothingness as one.
Types of offerings, and they correspond to the four letters of the Name <note>the Tetragrammaton: Y-H-V-H</note> and the heavens, corresponding to the ten for their beauty. All this is the likeness of the Name.
Also in God there are within him higher leaves, fifteen of heaven and knowledge, and his secret and his foundation, and they are the heavens.
And of the inclusions and the five is nothing. Also there is the aspect of the furnace and the thickness of the renewal, etc.
More than the bitterness of the six types of deaths, there are none, etc., and they are the soul of the worlds.
The soul of nothingness in the secret of the four deaths, as is known in the matter of the four deaths of the court.
For generations, and from there in the souls of the righteous in their foundation and in the likeness of the man who rides upon the heavens.
They are the souls of the righteous, which are in God as is known, and they are the second ones.
To include six types. The general world of the soul of man, for within it is the greatness.
From the great source, the four foundations which are as the straightness and the joy of the soul.
Which is the greatness and the soul of <term>Malchut</term> <gloss>Kingdom</gloss> in the secret of the soul.
In all its classes, and the soul of the kingdom in all its classes, and one like these for the souls.
As the soul is called by the name of the physical soul, it also rides on the foundations and the four sections of the desire.
When it is revealed for the nine aspects of the secret.
And behold, the action that he does for the days of the beginning of the end of his suckling is called by the name of greatness, but it is called the end of the three.
The word of its existence and its face are here, and the gates of the Hebrews, the generation.
The soul and the heavens which are called within it the name and the change, and it is the soul for the soul of here.
And the praise of the Levites. And the way of man is here, for man has within him the time of his birth in the field of his fruit.
And the soul is here in the spirit, and the waters of the four worlds: Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah.
These are the shells of the beginning of the selection of the secret, the birth in the field of his fruit.
To the unity of the second ones, three of them in the field of the type and for each one.
To count according to himself, the creation of my covenant upon two. To the messengers upon five.
Upon the revelation of the fruits. For the staff of the day, may God have mercy on us for every single thing.
Amen, may it be so and forever.

<note>A small decorative floral ornament marks the transition to the conclusion.</note>

Completed and finished is the holy book <term>Etz Chaim</term> <gloss>Tree of Life</gloss> with the help of God, Creator of Earth and Heavens.

It is good for the fullness of the soul of Israel, may they merit the beginning and the pillar of the soul's expansion, for the Tree of Life is for those who hold fast to it. And the work of his hand is the work of the holiness of the day, like one. And they will find favor on the day of the creation of the hidden light for the world to come, and to say within it etc. for the merit of the greatness of the soul.

-> O you who are unaware of such restriction, what are you doing? <-
-> The Absolute Beauty is shining from every side. <-

Although man is in the utmost density because of his physicality, he is in the ultimate subtlety because of his spirituality. Whatever he turns toward, he takes its command, and whatever he focuses on, he accepts its color. For this reason, the philosophers <note>original: "hukama"</note> have said that when the rational soul <note>original: "nafs-e natiqa"</note> becomes manifest through forms corresponding to the realities of things and is realized through true perception: "It becomes as if it were the whole of existence" <note>original Arabic: "sarat ka-annaha al-wujud kulluhu"</note>. Furthermore, common suitable imaginations, because of the intensity of their connection to this worldly form and perfect preoccupation with that material body, have become such that they do not know how to distinguish themselves from it and are unable to differentiate. As it says in the <term>Masnavi</term> <gloss>The Spiritual Couplets</gloss> by Mawlawi <note>Rumi</note>, may his secret be sanctified:

-> O brother, you are that very thought of yours, <-
-> The rest of you is just bone and fiber. <-
-> If your thought is a rose, you are a rose garden, <-
-> And if it is a thorn, you are fuel for the furnace. <-

Therefore, one must strive and free oneself from one's own sight and from professional and divine... <meta>continues on next page</meta>

And there are specific relationships and considerations in each level that 
are not in other levels, such as the level of <term>uluhiyyat</term> <gloss>Divinity</gloss>, <term>rububiyyat</term> <gloss>Lordship</gloss>, the level of <term>ubudiyyat</term> <gloss>Servanthood</gloss>, 
and <term>khalqiyyat</term> <gloss>Creativity/Cureaturehood</gloss>. Therefore, applying the names of the level of Divinity—for example, God <note>original: "Allah"</note> 
and the Compassionate <note>original: "Rahman"</note> and others—to the cosmic levels <gloss>maratib-i kawniyya</gloss> would be sheer infidelity and pure heresy <term>zindiqa</term>. 
Similarly, applying the names specific to the cosmic levels to the level of 
Divinity would be the height of error and the ultimate abandonment.

---

| O you who are at the head of the work, for you are the possessor of truth | And in the attribute of truthfulness and sincerity |
|--------------------------|-----------------------|
| Every level has a secret from Existence | If you preserve the levels, you will build a house <note>referring to spiritual stability</note> |

---

Being an "existent" is a single honor, and that is the very Existence of the Truth <term>Haqq</term> <gloss>the Real/God</gloss> 
and the Absolute Named. However, He has many levels. The first 
level is Non-determination <term>la ta'ayyun</term> and lack of limitation; it is freedom from every bond 
and consideration. From this perspective, He is transcendent from the addition of any description.

<summary>Jami warns against confusing the different ranks of existence, such as calling the creation "God," and introduces the highest level of being as Absolute and Undetermined.</summary>
<keywords>Divinity, Lordship, Servanthood, levels, heresy, Non-determination, Absolute Truth</keywords>

->APPENDIX I<-

->GHAZZĀLĪ ON ‘TAUḤĪD’¹<-

PRAISE be to God, the Creator and Restorer of all things; who does whatsoever He pleases, who is Master of the glorious throne and mighty force, and directs His sincere servants into the right way and the straight path; who favoureth them who have once borne testimony to the Unity by preserving their confessions from the darkness of doubt and hesitation; who directs them to follow His chosen apostle, upon whom be the blessing and peace of God; and to go after his most honourable companions, to whom He hath vouchsafed His assistance and direction, which is revealed to them in His essence and operation by the excellencies of His attributes, to the knowledge whereof no man attains but he that hath been taught by hearing.² To these, as touching His essence, He maketh known that He is One, and hath no partner; singular, without anything like Him; uniform, having no contrary; separate, having no equal.³ He is ancient, having no first; eternal, having no beginning; remaining for ever, having no end; continuing to eternity without any termination. He persists, never ceasing to be; remains without falling; and never did cease, nor ever shall cease, to be described by glorious attributes; nor is subject to any decree so as to be determined by any precise limits or set times, but is the First and the Last, and is within and without.

¹ This passage is given in Pococke's ‘Specimen Historiæ Arabum’ (Oxoniæ, 1650), p 284, and this translation of it by Ockley is copied from Hughes's ‘Notes on Muhammadanism.’
² ‘Faith cometh by hearing’ (Rom. x 17).
³ This is directed against the Christian Trinity, which all Moslems suppose to be the equivalent of Tritheism.

<vocab>Ghazzālī, Tauḥīd, Unity, God, attributes, essence, Pococke, Ockley, Muhammadanism, Trinity, Tritheism</vocab>

¹ This passage is given in Pococke's ‘Specimen Historiæ Arabum’ (Oxoniæ, 1650), p 284, and this translation of it by Ockley is copied from Hughes's ‘Notes on Muhammadanism.’
² ‘Faith cometh by hearing’ (Rom. x 17).
³ This is directed against the Christian Trinity, which all Moslems suppose to be the equivalent of Tritheism.

<summary>This page contains an introductory exposition by Ghazzālī on 'Tauḥīd' (Divine Unity), emphasizing God's uniqueness, eternality, and absolute oneness as a rejection of polytheism and the Christian Trinity.</summary>
<keywords>Ghazzālī, Tauḥīd, Divine Unity, God, Attributes, Trinity, Islam</keywords>

<margin>للمصروع</margin>
معجون ببعضها وضع منه حبة امثال الفلفل وسقي منه المصدوع كل يوم على الصبوح
<margin>من الوجع البارد</margin>
الربو وكل علة قديمة من الرئة عجيبا واما الخنفساء فكرام وايايه بوضعها نفعت من وجع الربو
وجع المفاصل والنقرس سيما اذا غليت على علم الرواة في زيت في المنضج ينفع من الحضاة
<margin>وجع المفاصل والنقرس</margin>
ونفع من النسمة والكرار واكلها المخلوعة بوجع الرابضة وكذا الدهن عمل
بها ان استفي منه صاحب النضج واما الاجف فبرمة مع جنباتها تسمى كبارا يقلع
دويّ النضج واما **الحرف** فالحياة بحرية وخلاف ما في لسانها من السّمّ كان ابلغ
في علل الشفا وخاصة سقيا واما قشر سنها واذا ذرّ في اللثة واما إناء الحلق على
<margin>للكلف والبرص والبهق</margin>
الرأس مضمضة مع سكر ربع او من كتاب الفلاحة ان البشرة اذا كوي بنزوله من الفزع
ثلاثة ايام متوالية في المنخار واما ريشها فادوية واكتمة على الأرض وبراها
ودخانها الى الهوام ونزلت كذالك ريش البطة واما **السمك** فكثير الأنواع
اوفره فالمرار الصلحفاة ان احرقت وهي في الفخار حصل في غضه فخار والحق في
<margin>للبواسير المتورمة والنزف</margin>
منه نفع للأشياء واذا ما يم حرق قطع نزف الذم والبواسير العنز والبله والبرص
اذا سحق عن بره فطلبا فأنها تجف في المار ويعق فيه الصبيان الي مرهم عمله

### سلحفاة
من نوره هو النحاة وسه كبيرة فيما بعد الربحة الله تعالى **بلور**
هو الحجر وثمر بقوم ذكر في ح ج و لا سيما سلحفاة من انوال السوس في جبلة
ومن الرأس هو إنام سحق انا على جراحه وامرهم في إصلاحها تسوي الحمر
وضربه كما في ندم **الريق** يستعمل في أدوية الحشوية النافعة من الخدرة

<margin>لمن به فزع...</margin>
### سليخا
والجدوار بالباء الضمنية ويسمى الحبر بجزيرة الأندلس
وسنة كثر الصرخة في حيرة الصمام ارقناء الله تعالى

### سمن
ليس مخدراً
<margin>مسعال الصبيان</margin>
بكلوا لى المهم والزيق ينفع لـ في الحلق ومنهم ما يقال له روي الرسول يتصيد
وهو بالعربية نها وانه نافعه انما يقي ما في الرئة قاشر تستعمله في
ادوية الحلق وسقيه ينفع من صورة شوكة وحزم الرأس ويعبأ في زق
<margin>للكلف والبرص</margin>
دواء لون الوجة الدم تلخ من وكن وكان غلبة الميساء ولم تنجح
في العضو كيف كان لابد لادم آلة الى الحمام ما لم تقف اللحية المبدة
جا شوتمرية الناعمة صافة الجبر في صروحه والزي لز مستعمل بياض الحبر
<meta>catchword: الذي لز</meta>

<column-break/>

<margin>للقولنج (؟)</margin>
... وان شرب وخلطة أجزاؤه وخلط معه وزنه زنجبيل نفع من نهش الهوام والسموم وبعد
<margin>للمسروع واللقوة</margin>
منه ربع قار لكل يوم نفع في الجهة صاحب الهوائم الباطنية والقديمة ينفع للمسروع
منه فنونا نيبا الرأس في خواجه واما ريشه سلح الجنة على ورم المراة الحامل
عند الفلو امسكه الهوام وليؤخر عنها او يماثلها **السمندل** في الغلظ الزرقا
توجد مروحة إمام أو النار ومن فرجها وريص بالأخرة منها وانما غسله الزيت
ويجلو في نار التوقت من بودرة في نعم من أمراء الأجفان ومن الرموش واشار
<margin>وجع المفاصل والظهر</margin>
في الحلق كما في جفرة من السم الهاني في أسامته التي اما اكبر ما جرى السم بقعر العصعص واما
<margin>الورم الحار</margin>
من الحية فرية امرأة فرو جعلت مشيمتها أوتاما وريمات في بعضها الفوات مائه وكأنها صحيحة مجربة
تجيب ويجري فيها الفرح فيما في اللحم

# سلندرا بنورث
وهو كرد افر وحشية في كتابه والي ميوية مرنيتها
الرأس نحو من ثلاثة اذرع رقيق في المواضع الوجة ريبونية ورية نضع
بعضه بعد وجبه على فرر الهشة الفم وساء اللسان منه يذيب من ابلع الأودية
لنهش الحيات والسموم كماء وأما السّموم واذا تمرضوا حتّي حضر في الحلوي واللقوة
<margin>سعال الصبيان والسل</margin>

### سقنقور
هو صفوف بروص رطب
في المفاصل والرئة امر اضربه في انفيه انية وحموز وان نوسر المراد ومن شر به
الحوار في هذا الدهر بوزن بوسر **الصرع** الخاصّة ودم **السلحفاة** البرية
ان أصره واحرق حيّا ومرار الصلحفاة تصلح للجنا واللوق واللقوة و
الحمية العارضة لجسده في ابواهم واذا وضعت في قذر لونه صدفة
نوبية الجسد سقم والاراد احرقت سلحفاة بحرية حتى يبيض بخره ويجف
<margin>الخنازير</margin>
مع الصمّ روم صعد على السرطان المتفرع نفع في وسخه وتجده وضعه
ان يقيد رسوا دلى دار في حيرة الفرح وحرق النار الميتة ينفع في حيرة
المعد المفاصل في المعد الحفاة ثلاثة انواع بحرية وبرية ونهرية و قد
تذبح السلحفاة الجبرية وتخرج ما في جوفها واجرف وخلط بماء يمر به نهن
<margin>للسرطان المتفرع والمسموم والصرع والبرص</margin>
من نلو او يحر يحصل ومنه العليل بالبواة و العشق فزدت في صفوة
نوع من اليلف والزيت وماء المجروم في الحيوة بحرية وذالك بر من فقهما

<margin>الحبشة</margin>
الحبشة فيها منه كركازي ومنه نوع آخر صغير كثير الشوك ورقه صغار وأعصانه فاو وطرقه الزراع رأيته بمر مزرعة الحجاز وسألت عنه بعض
<margin>البواسير</margin>
صاحب الحبشة فسمّاه لشوك العقرب وقال إنما تتبع من لسع العقرب لي يقع به أمثال مسواك
اليمن بل العجم ومن أيضاً نار من العامرة من البربار المصري رأيته بالمطرية
في البستان الذي به البلسان بغير شمرون كثر أمثال البر البردعة الثمرة
بحرها للبواسير يطبخها وينفع منها عجيب وذكر لي من أثق بقوله أن ماءه إذا شرب أزاله بالمرة سخونة
لوجع الأذن إذا طبخت في زيت وقطرت في الأذن وجعها وسادة الثمرة تشبه ثمر التفاح
في المنظر والفرسواء أنها تذرف التفاح في التشريد الحمد ما فاح حم
<margin>حر</margin>
حر هذا ابن سجون الحمر أسود أحم بالايض هو الحمر العبي وسمى
باليونانية مرواحم هو الحمر العامي المعروف ويسمى بالفارسية سندر
أبراجنية الحمر نوع منه ورقه مثل ورق الخلاف وله نور مثل نور الياسمين
سواء أبيض يضرب به البنفسج والنوع وموجب البنار وليست رائحته مثل
رائحة الزنبق وجنه سبعة مثل سنبله العشرو والنوع جم موالذي تفارقه
بالفارسية السبعة وسبعة ماء أمزورة وسنعة ثم للطلول والسنعة هي أوجة
التي يكون صاحبها بصفر يروسية الثلاثة والكروا الذي بين دماء ريفا
وبالبلاد التي تقال لها خلاكيا التي تأتيها واشمة من تميمية بعض
الناس منه أبا غير فستاني وهو ممر خرج من أحل واحد وله أغصان كثيرة وورق
أبيض ورؤوس أحم قليلاً مرؤوس التراب البنفسجي مثلثة فيها درر لونه إلى الحمرة
ماهرته وثلاث زوايا مرشه بز المرارة والبرز هو المشتعل ونجد يكون الحمر
جالينوس الطبقة فونه للكبود حارة في الدرجة الثالثة ولذالرها يقطع
<margin>خلاط</margin>
ما خلال الغليظة اللزجة ويخرج ما بالبول يسور مروم وإذا أخذ العسل
والشراب ومرارة الزجاج والزعفران وما الرازي يفتح الحاضم وأيضاً يفتح
<margin>نفع السمر</margin>
البم ومن الناس من تعميه حر ملا والقرى فيون يمنونه عامة وأمثال فياء ونيبا
مم الذين يمنونه مولا فيه شفا تسير للنسات ليت يقال له مولى إذا كان
أهل أبيض وينبت في البلاد وارض كبية المرنة مسيح الرمشتي الحمر فج

I saw it in the farms of the Hijaz and asked one of the owners in Ethiopia about it.
<margin>Hemorrhoids</margin>
He called it "Scorpion's Thorn" and said it is only followed <note>or "used for"</note> scorpion stings, as it causes something like a toothpick [to form].
In Yemen, or rather in the non-Arab lands, and also from the cultivated lands of the Egyptian Berber, I saw it in <term>Matariya</term> <note>a location in Cairo</note> in the garden where the balsam is, without <term>Shamrun</term> <gloss>a type of plant/growth</gloss>. It is abundant, like the <term>Bardha</term> <gloss>saddle/harness</gloss> fruit.
Its sea <note>or "essence"</note> is for hemorrhoids; one boils it, and it is remarkably effective. Someone I trust told me that if its water is drunk, it removes heat entirely.
For earache, if it is boiled in oil and dropped into the ear, it relieves the pain. The fruit resembles the fruit of the apple in appearance, but it is inferior to the apple in sweetness, praise be to God.
<margin>Heat</margin>
Heat: this <term>Ibn Sajun al-Hamr</term> <gloss>Red Son of the Ages</gloss> is black, red... it is the common red <term>Hamr</term> and is called in Greek <term>Marwaham</term>; it is the well-known common red [plant] and is called in Persian <term>Sandar</term>.
<term>Abrajaniya al-Hamr</term> is a type of it; its leaves are like the leaves of the <term>Khallaf</term> <gloss>willow</gloss> and it has blossoms like the jasmine, except it is white with a violet hue. The type and cause of the <term>Binar</term> <gloss>fire/burning</gloss>—its scent is not like the scent of the lily; its genus is seven, like the <term>Sunbul al-Ashr</term> <gloss>ear of ten</gloss>. The type... <term>Sab’a</term> <gloss>seven</gloss> in Persian is seven... <unclear>amzura</unclear>... and <unclear>sana</unclear>... and the <unclear>sana</unclear> are the faces that the owner has with yellow... the three and the <term>Karwa</term> <gloss>caraway</gloss> which is between the blood of <unclear>Rifa</unclear>. And in the lands called <term>Khalakiya</term> which the <unclear>washima</unclear> comes to from <term>Tamimiya</term>, some people say it is not garden-grown, but is a <term>Mumar</term> <gloss>passageway/wild variety</gloss> that emerges from one root. It has many branches, white leaves, and slightly red heads... [similar to] violet earth, triangular, with seeds the color of which is towards red, its skill <unclear>maharatuhu</unclear> and three corners... its bitterness... and the <term>Barz</term> <gloss>seed/grain</gloss> is the burning. And we find the <term>Hamr</term> <note>red plant</note>...
Galen says the class <unclear>funuhu</unclear> is hot in the third degree, and therefore it cuts...
<margin>Mixture</margin>
...what the thick, viscous mixtures mix, and it brings out what is in the urine... and if honey, wine, glass bile <note>likely a mineral or salt</note>, and saffron are taken. Al-Razi says it opens the <term>Hadim</term> <gloss>digestive/stomach</gloss> and also opens...
<margin>Benefit of the Red</margin>
...the <term>Bim</term> <gloss>a canal or vessel</gloss>. Some people call it <term>Hamr Mala</term> and the villages know it... and examples... they call it <term>Mawla</term> when it is white, and it grows in the lands and <unclear>kabiya</unclear> earth... the <term>Ramasti Hamr</term> <gloss>Red Ramasti</gloss>...

الزمان أسه فضا من عصارة وأسه تجريفا وفقد أكمام مرتين جميعا
مرجيه وجنية الزمان التي تساقط عن الشجر إذا أينعت وذرت على الحصاد أو يجمع معه
منع الفضول من أن تميل إلى المعدة وأمعاء وإذا أينع به ماء الملح ومن شأنه ينفع
فكان ينفع الدم وأنه أجفان المياه التي تليق بها وأنه فرحة معاً وسيلان
الرطوبة السائلة من الرحم المزمنة وعصارة حب الزمان وخاصة إذا مض
منه إذا لحم وخلط بالعسل كان وقافاً من الفروج الخبيثة وإلى الزايد ووجع
حمام أو الفروج أثني به بالجلنار والجلنار فايض يجفف من الله والملزق
للجراحات جراحتها ويصلح لكل ما يصلح له الزمان وقد تنقص طبيعة اللثة التي
تة ما كثيراً وأسنان المتحركة وفرعياً منه لزوق العقول التي تحمى بها معاً إلى
ثنيتين وفزوع قوة أنه من أصلع جبات جاح من ما يكون من الجلنار يعم في
له بقلة السنة زمر وفرتخرج عطارة الجلنار وكما تستخرج عصارة الميوبسكياس
وقوة فمي الزمان واضحة توافق كل ما يوافق الجلنار ولجميع أطبيعة الزمان
فتلجت الفرح وخرجه ووش الزمان الجلو ليس مريم المنخ والجامد فيه
للمعده بجزء معاً ويكفي الدم أبرص أين الزمان الجلوز الجامى أن أعصر
مع شحمها وشيء من عصريها منه أنصب وكلهم عصورهم من المشر أفضلا
أمرة للأصغر وقويا للمعدة وأكثر ما يؤخر منه عثم أو أفي مع حمم رام سكر
يقارب بأنهما إيقاوم إيليج بأصعب أحور سلما فذوي على إجزاز الرطوبات المرة اللينة
من المعدة وينفع مرجيات الغثاء لنتكاوة غير ينفع من الحكة والجرب
ورفع المعدة من أن يضم بعضها وشرابه وريه ذي وعار من الخار الرازي من هم
مطار أغزية أما الجلومنه ينبح قليلاً حتى أنه ينعث ويكثر الأطعام عن المعدة
أم أنشر تعره ولين يحتاج إلى طاحه أزيفه مريع النفس وأنا الحامي
بأنه كليل الرفوف في المعدة وينج وغيره الكبر تبريدا قويا واسما أن أزمن
وأخني وتغظم حررة المبرودين بيع الحمام ويمنعها من جذب الغذاء ينورهم
لزائر اسهالا وتهيج بهم الرياح وترتب بقهوة ملذال ينبغي أن ذدوم منه

In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
This is the manner of life for the people of the paths: the Shattariyya, the Naqshbandiyya, the Rifa'iyya, the 'Ishqiyya, and the Anfasiyya. This is four or five days, and three or four or five days, then you bathe. If you follow the path, you pray five rak'ahs <note>original: "units of prayer"</note> in three sets of salutations <note>original: "salam"</note>. This is the intention. This [is the method for] the seeker of the way. According to the Sunnah, obedience is to enter the path of the pious with two rak'ahs for Allah.

<meta>continues from previous page: ...as there are no</meta> verses, nor chapters, nor grammatical inflections, because these belong to speech composed of letters and sounds, and the Eternal Attribute is transcendent above letters and sounds, as has been established. These noble wordings do not indicate the Eternal Attribute in the sense that the Eternal Attribute is understood from them. Rather, what is understood from these wordings is equivalent to what is understood from the Eternal Attribute if the veil were lifted from us and we heard it. Therefore, understand that these wordings indicate a meaning, and this meaning is equivalent to what is understood from the Speech subsisting in the Essence of the Almighty. So, be diligent regarding this, for many fall into error concerning it. Both the Eternal Attribute and these noble wordings will be called the Quran and the Word of God. However, the wordings are created, written on the Preserved Tablet <note>original: "al-Lawh al-Mahfuz", the celestial record of all decreed events</note>. Gabriel brought them down to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, as a Quran. It descended on the Night of Decree <note>original: "Laylat al-Qadr"</note> to the House of Might <note>original: "Bayt al-'Izzah", an abode in the lowest heaven</note> located in the sky of the world. It was written in scrolls and placed therein. It is said that it descended to the House of Might all at once, then descended to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, over twenty years; it is also said twenty-three years, and also twenty-five years. It is said that there descended to the House of Might on the Night of Decree whatever was to descend each year, and it did not descend to the House of Might all at once. What descended upon him, may God bless him and grant him peace, was the wording and the meaning; and it is said that only the meaning descended upon him, and there is disagreement.



<margin>Manifested</margin>
its existence is a temporal manifestation of influence <note>original: "ta'alluq tanjizi hadith", meaning the attribute's action at the moment of the object's existence</note>. That is, after its existence, it is for the Almighty through His Hearing and Sight, in addition to the manifestation through Knowledge. Thus, they have two types of connection. As for the Almighty Himself and His Attributes, the connection is an eternal manifestation of influence; meaning that the Essence of the Almighty and His Attributes are manifested to the Almighty eternally through His Hearing and Sight. The Almighty hears His own Essence and all His manifest attributes, such as Power, Hearing, and others. We do not delve into the manner of this connection. The Almighty sees His own Essence and His existential attributes, such as Power, Sight, and others. We do not delve into the manner of this connection. That which was previously mentioned, that Hearing and Sight connect with every existent thing, is the view of al-Sanusi and those who followed him, and it is the preferred view. It is said that Hearing does not connect except with sounds, and Sight does not connect except with visible things. The Hearing of the Almighty is not by means of ears or auditory canals, and His Sight is not by means of a burning <note>meaning the physical sensation of sight</note> or eyelids that blink. He is exalted far above that. The thirteenth attribute of the Almighty is Speech. It is an eternal attribute subsisting in the Essence of the Almighty, not a letter nor a sound, transcendent above sequence, delay, grammatical inflection, and declension, unlike the speech of created things. It is not intended by His Necessary Speech that these are the noble wordings revealed to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, because these are created, while the Attribute subsisting in the Essence of the Almighty is eternal. These are composed of sequence, delay, inflection, chapters, and verses, whereas the Eternal Attribute is free from all of that, so there is not in it

<summary>This text discusses the nature of divine Speech as an eternal attribute, distinguishing it from the created, linguistic Quran, while also detailing the theological perspectives on God's attributes of Hearing and Sight.</summary>
<keywords>Divine Speech, Eternal Attributes, Quranic revelation, God's Hearing, God's Sight, Islamic theology</keywords>

<meta>continues from previous page: ...twelve: Pre-eternity (<term>al-qidam</term> <gloss>existence without beginning</gloss>), Everlastingness (<term>al-baqa'</term> <gloss>existence without end</gloss>), Dissimilarity to originated things (<term>al-mukhalafah lil-hawadith</term>), Self-subsistence (<term>al-qiyam bi-al-nafs</term>), which is expressed as absolute independence, Oneness (<term>al-wahdaniyyah</term>), Power, Will, Knowledge, Life, Hearing, Sight, and Speech. The <term>ma'nawiyyah</term> <gloss>attributive states</gloss> are omitted because their establishment is based on the doctrine of <term>al-ahwal</term> <gloss>modes/states</gloss>, and the truth is the contrary.</meta>

If you wish to learn the general attributes of the Exalted God, it is said: God the Exalted is Existent, Pre-eternal, Everlasting, Dissimilar to originated things, Independent of everything, All-Powerful, All-Knowing, All-Willing, All-Living, All-Hearing, All-Seeing, and All-Speaking. Their opposites are also known.

Know that some masters have distinguished between <term>al-ahwal</term> <gloss>modes</gloss> and <term>al-i'tibarat</term> <gloss>conceptual considerations</gloss>. They said: The <term>hal</term> <gloss>mode</gloss> and the <term>i'tibar</term> <gloss>consideration</gloss> are both neither existent nor non-existent; rather, they are realized in themselves. However, the <term>hal</term> has a connection to the essence, while the <term>i'tibar</term> has no connection to the essence. They say the <term>i'tibar</term> is realized outside the mind. This was objected to on the grounds that an <term>i'tibar</term> is an attribute, and if it has no connection to the essence and is realized outside the mind, then what is it describing? An attribute cannot exist by itself; there must be something described by it. The truth is that <term>i'tibar</term> has no realization except in the mind. There are two types: inventive <term>i'tibar</term>, which has no basis in existence, such as calling the generous person stingy or the ignorant person knowledgeable; and deductive <term>i'tibar</term>, which has a basis in external reality, such as the established standing of Zayd, which is deduced from your statement "Zayd is standing," and the attribution of standing to Zayd is established in external reality. End.



the seven <term>ma'nawiyyah</term> <gloss>attributive states</gloss>. These are forty doctrines: twenty are mandatory for God the Exalted, twenty are negated from Him, and there are twenty summary proofs, such as the proof for establishing an attribute and its negation. 

A caution: Some have said that things are of four types: existents, non-existents, modes (<term>ahwal</term>), and conceptual considerations (<term>i'tibarat</term>). Existents are like the Zayd you see; non-existents are like your statement "Zayd's standing" <note>referring to a potential action not currently realized</note>. Al-Sanusi followed this view—that things are four—in his <term>al-Sughra</term> <gloss>The Shorter Work</gloss>, because he affirmed the <term>ahwal</term> and made the mandatory attributes twenty, following the <term>ahwal</term> in others. According to this, the attributes are thirteen, because the seven <term>ma'nawiyyah</term> are dropped, which is "His being Powerful," etc. Thus, there is no attribute called "His being Powerful" unless it is required among the impossibilities, and so the impossibilities are also thirteen. 

As for existence being an attribute—or that it is other than existence—according to the view of Al-Ash'ari, existence is the very thing that exists. Therefore, His existence is His very essence, so existence is not an attribute, and the attributes are five. End.

<summary>This passage discusses the theological classification of God's attributes, specifically distinguishing between ontological attributes and conceptual considerations (i'tibarat), while noting the differing views of scholars like Al-Sanusi and the Ash'arite school.</summary>
<keywords>Theology, Attributes of God, Al-Sanusi, Al-Ash'ari, Ontological status, Modes, Conceptual considerations</keywords>

كان الرسول كاذبا لكان هذا الخبر كاذبا والكذب عليه تعالى محال فيكون كذب الرسل محالا وإذ انتفى عنهم الكذب ثبت لهم الصدق وأما دليل الأمانة أي عصمتهم ظاهرا وباطنا من محارم ومكروه أنهم لو كانوا بارتكاب محرم أو مكروه لكنا مأمورين بمثل ما يفعلونه ولا يصح أن نؤمر بمحرم أو مكروه لأن الله تعالى لا يأمر بالفحشاء فتعين أنهم لم يفعلوا إلا الطاعة أما واجبة أو مندوبة ولا يدخل أفعالهم المباحة لأنهم إذا فعلوا المباح يكون لبيان الجواز وأما دليل التبليغ فلانهم لو كتموا لكنا مأمورين بكتمان العلم ولا يصح أن نكتم العلم لأن كتمه ملعون فتعين أنهم لم يكتموا فثبت لهم التبليغ وأما دليل الفطانة أي الحذق لهم عليهم الصلاة والسلام فلانهم لو انتفت عنهم الفطانة لما قدروا أن يقيموا حجة على الخصام لكن إقامة الحجة منهم على الخصم دليل عليها اقتران في غير موضع وإقامة الحجة تكون إلا من الفطن وأما دليل جواز وقوع الأعراض البشرية بهم أنهم لا يزالون يترقون في المراتب العلمية ووقوع الأمراض بهم مثلا زيادة في مراتبهم العلية ولاجل أن يتسلى بهم غيرهم ويعرف العاقل أن الدنيا ليست دار جزاء للاحباب إذ لو كانت دار جزاء لاحباب الله لما أصابهم من تكدراتها صلى الله عليهم وعلى رئيسهم الأعظم سيدنا محمد

وعلى آله واصحابه واهاليته اجمعين ووردت الخمس عقبة باذلتها السمعية فاعلم انه يجب الايمان بان لنبينا صلى الله عليه وسلم حوضا والحمل يكون بعد الصراط او قبله لا يضر ترده الخلائق يوم القيامة وهو غير الكوثر الذي هو من الجنة وما يجب اعتقاده ان يشفع يوم القيامة في فصل القضاء تقف الناس ويتمنون الانصراف ولو للنار فيشفع في انصرافهم من الموقف وهذه الشفاعة مختصة به صلى الله عليه وسلم وما يجب اعتقاده ان الوقوع في الكبائر غير الكفر لا يوجب الكفر وتجب التوبة طالما ان الذنب ولو صغيرة على المعتمد فيها ولا تنقض التوبة بعوده الى الذنب بل يجب لهذا الذنب توبة جديدة ويجب على الشخص ان يجتنب التكبر والحسد والغيبة لقوله عليه الصلاة والسلام ان ابواب السماء حجابا يردون اعمال اهل الكبر والحسد والغيبة اي يمنعونها من الصعود فلا تقبل والحسد تمني زوال النعمة الغير سواء تمني ان تاتي له اي للحاسد اولا والكبر بطر الحق وغمص الخلق ومعنى بطر الحق رده على قائله ومعنى غمص الخلق الاستزراء بهم ويجب ايضا ان يترك النميمة وهي السعي بين الناس على وجه الافساد لانه ورد لا يدخل الجنة

if the messenger were a liar, this report would be false, and lying is impossible for God, the Exalted, so the lying of the messengers is impossible. Since lying is negated from them, truthfulness is established for them. As for the evidence of trustworthiness, meaning their protection—outwardly and inwardly—from forbidden and disliked things: if they were to commit a forbidden or disliked act, we would be ordered to do what they do. It is not valid for us to be ordered to do a forbidden or disliked act, because God, the Exalted, does not order indecency. Therefore, it is confirmed that they only did what was obedience—either mandatory or recommended. Their permissible actions do not enter into this because if they did a permissible act, it would be to clarify its permissibility. As for the evidence for conveying: if they had concealed anything, we would be ordered to conceal knowledge, and it is not valid for us to conceal knowledge, because concealing it is cursed. Therefore, it is confirmed that they did not conceal, so conveying is established for them. As for the evidence for intelligence, meaning their sharpness, peace be upon them: if intelligence were absent from them, they would not be able to establish evidence against their opponents. However, their establishment of evidence against the opponent is evidence of their intelligence, as it appears in more than one place, and the establishment of evidence cannot be except from the intelligent. As for the evidence for the permissibility of the occurrence of human conditions for them, it is because they are always rising in scientific ranks, and the occurrence of illnesses for them, for example, is an increase in their exalted ranks, and so that others may be consoled by them, and for the wise person to know that the world is not a place of reward for the beloved, for if it were a place of reward for God's beloved, they would not be afflicted by its troubles. May God bless them and their supreme leader, our master Muhammad.



and upon his family, his companions, and his people, all of them. The five articles of faith were mentioned with their auditory evidences. Know that it is mandatory to believe that our Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, has a basin <note>a pool or fountain in the afterlife</note>, and the watering will be after or before the bridge <note>the Sirat</note>. It does not harm the confusion of the creation on the Day of Resurrection, and it is other than the Al-Kawthar <note>a river in Paradise</note> which is from Paradise. What must be believed is that he will intercede on the Day of Resurrection for the start of the judgment; people will stand and wish for the end, even if it is to the Fire, so he will intercede for their departure from the waiting place, and this intercession is specific to him, may God bless him and grant him peace. What must be believed is that falling into major sins, other than disbelief, does not necessitate disbelief, and repentance is mandatory as long as the sin remains, even if it is a minor one, according to the relied-upon view. Repentance is not invalidated by returning to the sin, but a new repentance is required for this sin. A person must avoid pride, envy, and backbiting, because of his saying, peace be upon him: "The gates of heaven have guards who turn back the deeds of the people of pride, envy, and backbiting," meaning they prevent them from ascending, so they are not accepted. Envy is wishing for the disappearance of another's blessing, regardless of whether one wishes for it to come to himself—the envious person—or not. Pride is rejecting the truth and belittling the people. The meaning of rejecting the truth is rejecting it to its speaker, and the meaning of belittling the people is holding them in contempt. It is also mandatory to abandon tale-bearing, which is walking between people for the sake of corruption, because it was reported: "He will not enter Paradise..."
